title: Orange Infused Brazilian Chicken Wrap
description: A rich and silky Brazilian dish featuring orange blossom water, served in a low-calorie corn husk wrap, perfect for a solo dinner
instructions: Preheat a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat
Add the olive oil and cook the chicken until browned, about 5 minutes
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant
Add the orange blossom water and cook for 1 minute, until the liquid is almost completely evaporated
Season the chicken with salt and black pepper
Warm the corn husks by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20 seconds
Assemble the wraps by placing a portion of the chicken onto the center of each corn husk
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve immediately
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
